floorPlans.introduction: Compare the published Tower A apartments on levels 12–23 and 25–32, and the separate Sky Edition layouts on levels 49–59. The Sky Edition brochure includes unit-level dimensions and storage on the pages after each drawing.
floorPlans.note: Standard plans show the published saleable area. Sky Edition ranges include the external store. Confirm the dimensions and area for your unit.

additionalDocuments.label: SeaHaven Sky Edition original brochure · Sobha Realty

review: Verified the exterior from Sobha’s project menu, the main brochure artwork and annotated aerial locator, and ten original Tower A drawings. The separate Sky Edition PDF provides three full drawings with matching area tables on pages 35, 37 and 39. Sobha’s official press release confirms Tower A levels 49–59. The Type B table shows unit 5701 where its drawing lists 5703, so the selector displays the documented overall range and leaves unit identification to the original documents.
unavailable: Complete original unit sheets for Towers B and C were not verified.
Exact entrance coordinates were not verified. Directions use the named project in Dubai Harbour.
Sobha’s time to an international cruise terminal does not identify the specific terminal. The aerial map labels a terminal in the harbour. The published time is omitted.
